CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    ms.library_material_status_code AS status_code,
    ms.library_material_status AS material_status,
    d.term_code,
    atab.term_description AS term_description,
    d.subject_id,
    so.offer_dept_code,
    so.offer_dept_name,
    so.offer_school_name,
    d.library_course_instructor_key
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail d
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status ms 
    ON d.library_material_status_key = ms.library_material_status_key
  LEFT JOIN academic_terms atab 
    ON d.term_code = atab.term_code
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered so 
    ON d.library_subject_offered_key = so.library_subject_offered_key
)
SELECT 
  status_code,
  material_status,
  term_code,
  term_description,
  COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS total_courses,
  COUNT(*) AS total_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT offer_dept_code) AS dept_occurrences,
  COUNT(DISTINCT offer_school_name) AS school_occurrences,
  COUNT(DISTINCT library_course_instructor_key) AS total_instructors
FROM base
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY term_code DESC, status_code

LIMIT 100

# Aggregate by status and term; include all statuses even if subject_offered missing; use instructor department/unit as proxies for dept/school occurrences

sql = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    ms.library_material_status_code AS status_code,
    ms.library_material_status AS material_status,
    d.term_code,
    atab.term_description AS term_description,
    d.subject_id,
    ci.department AS instr_department,
    ci.unit AS instr_unit,
    d.library_course_instructor_key
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail d
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status ms 
    ON d.library_material_status_key = ms.library_material_status_key
  LEFT JOIN academic_terms atab 
    ON d.term_code = atab.term_code
  LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor ci 
    ON d.library_course_instructor_key = ci.library_course_instructor_key
)
SELECT 
  status_code,
  material_status,
  term_code,
  term_description,
  COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS total_courses,
  COUNT(*) AS total_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(instr_department,'')) AS dept_occurrences,
  COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(instr_unit,'')) AS school_occurrences,
  COUNT(DISTINCT library_course_instructor_key) AS total_instructors
FROM base
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY term_code DESC, status_code
LIMIT 100
'''
